spec_acceptance_criteria.description: OrderSyncJob replaces OrderSyncService (Integrations, queue=integrations, cron */5 min)
Integrations + WhatsAppAnalytics: AddInvektoHangfire servers added (new queues)
NightlyBatchConfig + NightlyTenantConfig extracted to separate file; old BackgroundService deleted

spec_architectural_decisions.decision: Two new Hangfire servers: queue=integrations (Invekto.Integrations) and queue=waanalytics (Invekto.WhatsAppAnalytics)
spec_architectural_decisions.reason: Queue-per-service isolation preserved. Short 'waanalytics' per Q's interview answer (vs long 'whatsappanalytics').
spec_architectural_decisions.codex_note: EXPECTED: Two new AddInvektoHangfire calls. Both services FATAL if Hangfire conn string is missing (not gated) — matches Faz 1 Automation/Appointments which also FATAL without Hangfire.

spec_architectural_decisions.decision: NightlyBatch cron built from config RunHour at startup: $"0 {RunHour} * * *"
spec_architectural_decisions.reason: Config-driven cron matches existing appsettings semantics (default 02:00). Restart required if RunHour changes — acceptable per Q answer (option A).
spec_architectural_decisions.codex_note: EXPECTED: No per-hour tick + in-handler RunHour check.

spec_architectural_decisions.decision: NightlyBatchJob class renamed — old BackgroundService class deleted; new Hangfire class same name NightlyBatchJob placed under Services/Jobs/. NightlyBatchConfig + NightlyTenantConfig moved to Services/NightlyBatchConfig.cs
spec_architectural_decisions.reason: Prior file was confusingly named NightlyBatchJob despite being a BackgroundService. New class reuses the cleaner name and lives alongside other Hangfire jobs.
spec_architectural_decisions.codex_note: EXPECTED: File rename visible as delete+add. Two new files: Services/Jobs/NightlyBatchJob.cs + Services/NightlyBatchConfig.cs.

spec_architectural_decisions.decision: Config Enabled=false short-circuits the recurring job handler (not the registration)
spec_architectural_decisions.reason: Registration is idempotent; if config later flips Enabled=true without redeploy (not currently supported), handler already handles. Simpler than conditional registration at startup.
spec_architectural_decisions.codex_note: EXPECTED: Handler first-line check on _config.Enabled returning early.

spec_architectural_decisions.decision: OrderSyncJob: no tenant_id top-level arg — service-wide iterator over GetActiveAccountsForSyncAsync
spec_architectural_decisions.reason: Matches prior OrderSyncService pattern; per-account processing is tenant-scoped.

plan.summary: Faz 5 (final) of G7 Hangfire migration: OrderSyncService and NightlyBatchJob (BackgroundService) migrate to Hangfire recurring jobs. Integrations + WhatsAppAnalytics each get their own Hangfire server (queue=integrations / queue=waanalytics). All 10 original schedulers now on Hangfire; queue consumer workers remain IHostedService (out of scope).

(4) Backend + integrations queue names. (5) Production config: Integrations + WhatsAppAnalytics Hangfire conn string Q tarafından elle eklenecek (deploy talimatına yazılacak).
